name: tiro-scribe
description: Privacy-first clinical research app with on-device AI processing

scripts.clean: watchman watch-del-all 2>/dev/null || true; pnpm run clean:metro; rm -rf .expo coverage build ios/Pods ios/build ios/DerivedData android/.gradle android/app/build android/app/.cxx android/build; find . -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -delete 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.clean:all: pnpm run clean && pnpm run clean:native && rm -rf node_modules && pnpm install
scripts.prebuild:clean: pnpm run clean:native && pnpx expo prebuild
scripts.pods:clean: cd ios && pod deintegrate && pod install
scripts.module:build: cd modules/secure-recorder && pnpx expo-module clean && pnpx expo-module tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.android:dev: STORYBOOK_ENABLED=false pnpm run clean:metro && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON scripts/AndroidDev.ts
scripts.android:fresh: STORYBOOK_ENABLED=false pnpm run clean:metro && pnpm run prebuild:clean && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON scripts/AndroidDev.ts
scripts.ios:dev: STORYBOOK_ENABLED=false pnpm run preios && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON scripts/HeavyTask.ts ios-pods 30 pnpm run pods:install && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON scripts/HeavyTask.ts ios-build 30 expo run:ios
scripts.ios:fresh: STORYBOOK_ENABLED=false pnpm run preios && pnpm run prebuild:clean && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON scripts/HeavyTask.ts ios-build 30 expo run:ios
scripts.android:logcat: adb logcat -c && adb logcat ReactNativeJS:V ReactNative:V RCTLog:V Expo:V *:S
scripts.test:kotlin: if [ -d 'android' ] && [ -f 'android/gradlew' ]; then cd android && ./gradlew :secure-recorder:testDebugUnitTest; else echo 'Error: Android project not found'; exit 1; fi
scripts.test:swift: if [ -d 'ios' ] && [ -d 'ios/TiroScribe.xcworkspace' ]; then cd ios && xcodebuild test -workspace TiroScribe.xcworkspace -scheme TiroScribe -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator'; else echo 'Error: iOS workspace not found'; exit 1; fi
scripts.test:all: pnpm jest; pnpm run test:kotlin || true; pnpm run test:swift || true
